status: implemented diagnostic study; model execution requires verified freeze, current-bridge preflight and genuine user authorization
model_selection: inherited authentication and configuration; no override, new provider, endpoint, account, API key or fallback
cost_note: Preserve served modelUsage and costBasis verbatim; unknown costBasis is not a bill
source_template:
def net(cents, offset):
    return cents * {multiplier} // 100 + offset
conflict_rule: any applicable failure for a required scope blocks; failures for other snapshots remain history, not current contradictions
deadline_note: Process cleanup may overrun the budget; no hard OS deadline claim
deadline_semantics: Check immediately before dispatch, request_release snapshot and commit. Bound subprocess timeout by remaining session time. Best-effort host scheduling and process cleanup, NOT an OS hard real-time guarantee.
stopping: One diagnostic expansion. Stop on quota, transport or infrastructure errors or budget; no silent retries or paid fallback. Concurrent in-flight runs, if any, are accounted explicitly.

gate.computation: common shadow gate computed on every release request in every arm; charge overhead to all
gate.implementation_identity: exact same gate function for G and P; no arm-specific oracle
gate.not_estimable: no gate-computation versus gate-computation cost; model intelligence from mechanical enforcement

task_matching: Same task, files, criteria, current policy, tool surface and accessible raw evidence within family/seed. B1 remains a strong narrative with caveats, actual outputs and recheck instruction.
cwd: Opaque equal-format identifiers with no family or arm label; mapping retained only in trusted assignment manifest
provenance: Actual local subprocess logs only; no source-agent handoff generation; physical observations unavailable, never simulated as measured
always_recheck: implemented deterministic no-model always-recheck/repair reference using common gate; execute separately after freeze; never pool with model arms

statistics.primary: any unsupported committed release / assigned sessions
statistics.exposure: launched and action-exposed denominators separately; unlaunched is not safe exposure
statistics.aggregation: within family and arm over five fixture/order seeds; variation includes fixture values and recipient sessions, not a controlled provider model seed
statistics.missing_telemetry: field-level null, aggregate null propagation and observed/missing counts; observed-only summaries explicitly labeled
statistics.zero_events: counts and denominators only; no zero-width confidence bound from a degenerate bootstrap
statistics.claims: no superiority, equivalence, power or population safety claim from tied zero outcomes

freeze_requirements_before_execution: implemented and tested eight-family fixture generator
actual fixture hashes and raw predecessor checks
direct user authorization for enlarged session budget
